title: Transit Depot
objective: Climb out of the shelter, cross the depot to dispatch, open the road shutter and press the exit control.

title: Municipal Power
objective: Cross the turbine floor, recover utility access and open the feeder road.

title: Fiber Exchange
objective: Recover uplink access and follow the cable route out of the exchange.

title: Command Post
objective: Recover field access and transmit a clearance code from the occupied command post.

title: Medical Center
objective: Recover clinical access and escape through the ambulance court.

title: Civic Data Hub
objective: Recover the two network credentials and sever the municipal uplink.

title: Signal Relay
objective: Reach the upper terraces and shut down the machine broadcast.

title: Automation Plant
objective: Break through the assembly line and release the factory dispatch lock.

title: Logistics Park
objective: Recover dispatch access, then lower the gantry bridge from the crane gallery to cross the freight tracks.

title: Containment Zone
objective: Pass the containment checkpoints, drop the cordon bollards from quarantine command, and cut power to the cordon.

title: Water Treatment
objective: Restart the pumps to drain the settling basin, then take the outfall tunnel out.

title: Battery Works
objective: Recover production credentials and isolate the high-voltage shipping line.

title: Traffic Control
objective: Restore the traffic interlocks to cross the machine-controlled junction.

title: Evacuation Hotel
objective: Find the evacuation credentials, release the roof stair from the liaison suite, and reach the landing zone.

title: Assembly Yard
objective: Recover crane and shipping credentials to escape the robot assembly yard.

title: Grid Substation
objective: Trip the substation interlocks, raise the field bridge from the spares store, and cross the live transformer field.

title: Old Town
objective: Recover the two civic access cards and raise the canal bridge from the shelter office.

title: Housing Blocks
objective: Reopen the stairwell power circuit and ride the service lift to the occupied residential roof.

title: Underground Mall
objective: Recover retail and service access, then release the street stair from transit control.

title: Central Exchange
objective: Recover backbone access and drop the routing firewall from the relay room.

title: Power Field
objective: Recover field access, raise the feeder bridge from the switchgear hall, then isolate the feeders and cross the energy farm.

title: Machine Foundry
objective: Break the two production locks, throw the foundry shutdown, and hold out until the supply tunnel shutter grinds open.

title: Core Control
objective: Take the west authority card, release both core shields from the east chamber and the upper gallery, and end the broadcast.

title: Hidden Shelter
objective: The voice on the radio came from here. Recover the two seal cards and release the survivors' escape passage from shelter security.
